name: date-picker
title: DatePicker
description: A date or a range of dates, typed into a text field (read with date-fns in a format, yyyy-MM-dd by default) or picked from a Calendar in a popup, on InputGroup and Base UI's Popover, in three sizes.
usage: Use DatePicker for a day in a form or a filter (a restore point, a snapshot date), and mode="range" for a window of days (query history, an audit period). Put it in a Field after a FieldLabel: the text field takes the label, description and validity. The value is a local Date at midnight (range: { from, to }, both ends), or null when empty or when the text is not a date in format; with TanStack Form wire value, onValueChange and onBlur to the field, and validate null as missing. Limit the days with min, max and disabledDays (react-day-picker matchers, such as { dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }). Pass a date-fns locale for the calendar's language and first weekday; keep format unambiguous (yyyy-MM-dd, or dd/MM/yyyy where the locale reads it). For a time of day use TimePicker beside it; for a calendar that stays visible, Calendar.

props.name: mode
props.description: One day, or a range of two (typed as "from – to", picked with two clicks).

props.name: value
props.type: Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null
props.description: Controlled value; null when empty or when the text is not a date.

props.name: defaultValue
props.type: Date | { from: Date; to: Date } | null
props.description: Initial value when uncontrolled.

props.name: onValueChange
props.description: Called with the new day or complete range, or null, when a day is picked or the typed text is read (on blur and Enter).

props.name: format
props.description: The date-fns pattern the text is read and written in.

props.name: locale
props.description: The calendar's language and first weekday, and the month names in format.

props.name: min
props.description: The earliest day that can be picked or typed; the calendar does not go before its month.

props.name: max
props.description: The latest day that can be picked or typed.

props.name: disabledDays
props.description: More days the calendar does not offer: { dayOfWeek: [0, 6] }, a list of dates, a function.

props.name: weekStartsOn
props.description: First day of the week in the calendar, over the locale's.

props.name: numberOfMonths
props.description: Months side by side in the popup.

props.name: size
props.description: Control height from size.control.*, which follows data-density.

props.name: placeholder
props.description: Shown while the text is empty; the format by default.

props.name: calendarLabel
props.description: Accessible name of the calendar button and of the calendar ("Choose dates" for a range).

props.name: open
props.description: Controlled open state of the popup; defaultOpen and onOpenChange as in Base UI.

props.name: name
props.description: The form field name of the text field, which submits the text; a Field's name wins.

props.name: required
props.description: The text field must not be empty when the form submits.

props.name: disabled
props.description: Ignores interaction; a Field's disabled sets it too, and disables the button.

props.name: readOnly
props.description: The text can be selected, not changed, and the popup does not open.

props.name: aria-label
props.description: Accessible name of the text field when there is no FieldLabel.

props.name: className
props.description: Extra classes for the frame, merged after the component's own.

props.name: ref
props.description: Reaches the text <input>.

slots.name: root
slots.description: The InputGroup frame; data-slot="date-picker" and data-size. The popup is placed against it.

slots.name: input
slots.description: The text field, Base UI's Input; data-slot="input-group-input", aria-invalid while its text is not a date.

slots.name: trigger
slots.description: The calendar button, a ghost InputGroupButton with aria-haspopup="dialog"; data-slot="date-picker-trigger" and data-popup-open.

slots.name: positioner
slots.description: In a portal at the end of <body>, at z.dropdown, with the frame's data-theme and data-density; data-slot="date-picker-positioner".

slots.name: popup
slots.description: role="dialog" holding the Calendar, color.bg.overlay with elevation.overlay; data-slot="date-picker-popup".

states.name: focus-visible
states.description: Keyboard focus: a ring of ring.width in color.ring around the frame (the text field) or the button, and on the day in the calendar.

states.name: open
states.description: The calendar is open: the button is color.interactive.active.

states.name: entering
states.description: The popup fades in over motion.duration.fast with motion.easing.enter, and out with motion.easing.exit.

states.name: invalid
states.description: The text is not a date in format, or is outside min and max (aria-invalid), or the Field is invalid: color.status.danger.border borders.

states.name: selected
states.description: The chosen day in the calendar, or an end of the range: color.accent.bg.

states.name: disabled
states.description: Ignores interaction; the frame dims to opacity.disabled and the button is disabled.

accessibility: The text field is named by its FieldLabel (or aria-label), described by FieldDescription and FieldError, and aria-invalid while its text is not a date; the placeholder shows the format to type.
The calendar button is named by calendarLabel ("Choose date") and has aria-haspopup="dialog" and aria-expanded; Alt+ArrowDown in the text field opens the calendar too.

When the popup opens, focus moves to the chosen day (else today); the arrow keys, PageUp and PageDown move it, Enter or Space picks it, and the popup closes and returns focus to the text field. Escape closes it without a change.
The calendar is a role="grid" per month with full-date labels on the days; days outside min, max or disabledDays are disabled and struck through.
Everything the popup does can be done by typing the date, so the field also works without a pointer or the popup.
